001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.format;
002
003import java.util.LinkedHashSet;
004import java.util.List;
005import java.util.Objects;
006
007import org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable;
008
009import io.jstach.rainbowgum.KeyValues;
010import io.jstach.rainbowgum.KeyValues.KeyValuesConsumer;
011import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogEvent;
012import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogFormatter;
013import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogFormatter.KeyValueNullStrategy;
014import io.jstach.rainbowgum.annotation.CaseChanging;
015
016/**
017 * Builds a {@link LogFormatter} that appends event key values percent encoded, or as
018 * JSON, JSON5, or logfmt text, directly to a {@link StringBuilder}. The default writes
019 * all keys percent encoded, preserving their order, which reads back exactly with
020 * {@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.PercentCodec#decode(CharSequence, java.nio.charset.Charset)}.
021 * In JSON and JSON5 non-null values are always strings, even when they look like numbers,
022 * booleans, or JSON.
023 * <p>
024 * Compose it with other formatters through
025 * {@link LogFormatter.Builder#keyValues(java.util.function.Consumer)}, or
026 * {@link LogFormatter.Builder#add(LogFormatter)} with a built formatter:
027 * {@snippet :
028 * LogFormatter formatter = LogFormatter.builder()
029 *      .message()
030 *      .text(" ")
031 *      .add(new KeyValuesFormatterBuilder().format(KeyValuesFormatterBuilder.Format.JSON5)
032 *              .nullStrategy(LogFormatter.KeyValueNullStrategy.SKIP)
033 *              .build())
034 *      .newline()
035 *      .build();
036 * }
037 * <p>
038 * JSON and JSON5 results include braces, including {@code {}} when no keys are written;
039 * percent encoding and logfmt have no braces and write nothing when no keys are written.
040 * The builder is mutable; each built formatter is immutable and thread-safe.
041 */
042public final class KeyValuesFormatterBuilder {
043
044        /**
045         * Syntax of the key values object.
046         */
047        @CaseChanging
048        public enum Format {
049
050                /**
051                 * Percent encoded like a URI query, the default:
052                 * <code>requestId=42&amp;user=Ada%20Lovelace</code>. Keys and values are encoded
053                 * with {@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.PercentCodec}, so every key value is
054                 * reversible and on one line.
055                 */
056                PERCENT,
057                /**
058                 * JSON, with every key enclosed in double quotes.
059                 */
060                JSON,
061                /**
062                 * JSON5, with identifier keys left unquoted. Other keys and all string values
063                 * still use JSON double quotes and escaping. Identifier keys follow the
064                 * <a href="https://spec.json5.org/#objects">JSON5 object syntax</a>.
065                 */
066                JSON5,
067                /**
068                 * <a href="https://brandur.org/logfmt">logfmt</a>: space separated
069                 * <code>key=value</code> pairs, <code>requestId=42 user="Ada Lovelace"</code>. A
070                 * value is quoted only when it is empty or contains a space, <code>=</code>,
071                 * <code>"</code>, or a control character. Characters logfmt does not allow in
072                 * keys, and <code>%</code>, are percent-encoded (<code>a b</code> is
073                 * <code>a%20b</code>), and an empty key is <code>%</code>, so different keys stay
074                 * different.
075                 */
076                LOGFMT;
077
078        }
079
080        private @Nullable List<String> keys;
081
082        private KeyValueNullStrategy nullStrategy = KeyValueNullStrategy.KEEP;
083
084        private Format format = Format.PERCENT;
085
086        /**
087         * Creates a builder that writes all event key values percent encoded.
088         */
089        public KeyValuesFormatterBuilder() {
090        }
091
092        /**
093         * Selects the keys to write, in the supplied order. The list is copied and duplicate
094         * keys are written once at their first position. An empty list writes {@code {}}.
095         * Missing selected keys follow the null strategy, just like keys mapped to null.
096         * @param keys keys to select.
097         * @return this builder.
098         */
099        public KeyValuesFormatterBuilder keys(List<String> keys) {
100                this.keys = List.copyOf(new LinkedHashSet<>(keys));
101                return this;
102        }
103
104        /**
105         * Selects all keys, in the order supplied by the event's key values. This is the
106         * default and resets a previous {@link #keys(List)} selection.
107         * @return this builder.
108         */
109        public KeyValuesFormatterBuilder allKeys() {
110                this.keys = null;
111                return this;
112        }
113
114        /**
115         * Controls null values, and missing keys when a selection is supplied:
116         * {@link KeyValueNullStrategy#KEEP} writes {@code null} (logfmt: <code>key=</code>,
117         * percent encoding: the key alone), {@link KeyValueNullStrategy#EMPTY} writes an
118         * empty string, and {@link KeyValueNullStrategy#SKIP} omits the key. The default is
119         * KEEP.
120         * @param nullStrategy null value strategy.
121         * @return this builder.
122         */
123        public KeyValuesFormatterBuilder nullStrategy(KeyValueNullStrategy nullStrategy) {
124                this.nullStrategy = Objects.requireNonNull(nullStrategy);
125                return this;
126        }
127
128        /**
129         * Selects the syntax. The default is {@link Format#PERCENT}.
130         * @param format syntax to write.
131         * @return this builder.
132         */
133        public KeyValuesFormatterBuilder format(Format format) {
134                this.format = Objects.requireNonNull(format);
135                return this;
136        }
137
138        /**
139         * Builds an immutable formatter independent of subsequent builder changes.
140         * @return key values formatter.
141         */
142        public LogFormatter build() {
143                return build(true);
144        }
145
146        /* TTLL supplies the braces and suppresses empty key values. */
147        LogFormatter buildUnbraced() {
148                return build(false);
149        }
150
151        private LogFormatter build(boolean braces) {
152                return switch (format) {
153                        case JSON, JSON5 -> new JsonKeyValuesFormatter(keys, nullStrategy, format, braces);
154                        case PERCENT -> new PercentKeyValuesFormatter(keys, nullStrategy);
155                        case LOGFMT -> new LogfmtKeyValuesFormatter(keys, nullStrategy);
156                };
157        }
158
159}
160
161record JsonKeyValuesFormatter(@Nullable List<String> keys, KeyValueNullStrategy nullStrategy,
162                KeyValuesFormatterBuilder.Format syntax,
163                boolean braces) implements LogFormatter.EventFormatter, KeyValuesConsumer<StringBuilder> {
164
165        @Override
166        public void format(StringBuilder output, LogEvent event) {
167                if (braces) {
168                        output.append('{');
169                }
170                var keyValues = event.keyValues();
171                var selected = keys;
172                if (selected == null) {
173                        keyValues.forEach(this, 0, output);
174                }
175                else {
176                        int count = 0;
177                        for (String key : selected) {
178                                count = accept(keyValues, key, keyValues.getValueOrNull(key), count, output);
179                        }
180                }
181                if (braces) {
182                        output.append('}');
183                }
184        }
185
186        @Override
187        public int accept(KeyValues values, String key, @Nullable String value, int count, StringBuilder output) {
188                if (value == null) {
189                        switch (nullStrategy) {
190                                case SKIP -> {
191                                        return count;
192                                }
193                                case EMPTY -> value = "";
194                                case KEEP -> {
195                                }
196                        }
197                }
198                if (count > 0) {
199                        output.append(',');
200                }
201                if (syntax == KeyValuesFormatterBuilder.Format.JSON5 && isIdentifier(key)) {
202                        output.append(key);
203                }
204                else {
205                        appendString(output, key);
206                }
207                output.append(':');
208                if (value == null) {
209                        output.append("null");
210                }
211                else {
212                        appendString(output, value);
213                }
214                return count + 1;
215        }
216
217        /* JSON5 uses ECMAScript IdentifierName, not Java identifier rules. */
218        static boolean isIdentifier(String key) {
219                if (key.isEmpty()) {
220                        return false;
221                }
222                int first = key.codePointAt(0);
223                if (!isIdentifierStart(first)) {
224                        return false;
225                }
226                for (int i = Character.charCount(first); i < key.length();) {
227                        int c = key.codePointAt(i);
228                        if (!isIdentifierStart(c) && c != 0x200c && c != 0x200d) {
229                                boolean part = switch (Character.getType(c)) {
230                                        case Character.NON_SPACING_MARK, Character.COMBINING_SPACING_MARK, Character.DECIMAL_DIGIT_NUMBER,
231                                                        Character.CONNECTOR_PUNCTUATION ->
232                                                true;
233                                        default -> false;
234                                };
235                                if (!part) {
236                                        return false;
237                                }
238                        }
239                        i += Character.charCount(c);
240                }
241                return true;
242        }
243
244        private static boolean isIdentifierStart(int c) {
245                return c == '$' || c == '_' || switch (Character.getType(c)) {
246                        case Character.UPPERCASE_LETTER, Character.LOWERCASE_LETTER, Character.TITLECASE_LETTER,
247                                        Character.MODIFIER_LETTER, Character.OTHER_LETTER, Character.LETTER_NUMBER ->
248                                true;
249                        default -> false;
250                };
251        }
252
253        /*
254         * Quotes and escapes, as a JSON string, the text from start to the end of the output.
255         * Text needing no escapes, the common case, is only wrapped in quotes.
256         */
257        static void quoteInPlace(StringBuilder output, int start) {
258                int end = output.length();
259                for (int i = start; i < end; i++) {
260                        char c = output.charAt(i);
261                        if (c == '"' || c == '\\' || c < 0x20 || c == '\u2028' || c == '\u2029' || Character.isSurrogate(c)) {
262                                String raw = output.substring(start);
263                                output.setLength(start);
264                                appendString(output, raw);
265                                return;
266                        }
267                }
268                output.insert(start, '"');
269                output.append('"');
270        }
271
272        static void appendString(StringBuilder output, String value) {
273                output.append('"');
274                for (int i = 0; i < value.length(); i++) {
275                        char c = value.charAt(i);
276                        switch (c) {
277                                case '"' -> output.append("\\\"");
278                                case '\\' -> output.append("\\\\");
279                                case '\b' -> output.append("\\b");
280                                case '\f' -> output.append("\\f");
281                                case '\n' -> output.append("\\n");
282                                case '\r' -> output.append("\\r");
283                                case '\t' -> output.append("\\t");
284                                default -> {
285                                        if (c < 0x20 || c == '\u2028' || c == '\u2029') {
286                                                appendUnicodeEscape(output, c);
287                                        }
288                                        else if (Character.isHighSurrogate(c)) {
289                                                if (i + 1 < value.length() && Character.isLowSurrogate(value.charAt(i + 1))) {
290                                                        output.append(c).append(value.charAt(++i));
291                                                }
292                                                else {
293                                                        appendUnicodeEscape(output, c);
294                                                }
295                                        }
296                                        else if (Character.isLowSurrogate(c)) {
297                                                appendUnicodeEscape(output, c);
298                                        }
299                                        else {
300                                                output.append(c);
301                                        }
302                                }
303                        }
304                }
305                output.append('"');
306        }
307
308        private static void appendUnicodeEscape(StringBuilder output, char c) {
309                String hex = "0123456789abcdef";
310                output.append("\\u")
311                        .append(hex.charAt((c >>> 12) & 0xf))
312                        .append(hex.charAt((c >>> 8) & 0xf))
313                        .append(hex.charAt((c >>> 4) & 0xf))
314                        .append(hex.charAt(c & 0xf));
315        }
316
317}
